text.en:
Parts of Section 2 of P.D. No. 1177 are hereby amended to read as follows:
"d. "Current operating expenditures" refers to appropriations for the purchase of goods and services for
current consumption or whose benefits are expected to terminate within the fiscal year."
"g. "Government-owned or controlled corporations" shall include all corporations and financial institutions
owned or controlled by the National Government and performing governmental and/or proprietary functions."

Section 27 of P.D. No. 1177 is hereby amended to read as follows:
"Sec. 27. Schedule of Budget Consideration. The Committee on Appropriations shall report the general
appropriations bill to the National Assembly within seven consecutive session days after the bill has been
referred to it.
"The National Assembly shall start the discussion of said bill on second reading likewise within seven
consecutive session days from the day of submission of said report.
"Debate shall be terminated on or before the eighteenth consecutive session day from the beginning of the
discussions. Final action thereon shall be taken within three consecutive session days after the submission on
the printed bill incorporating approved amendments: Provided, That a printed statement of final amendments
shall be sufficient basis for approval of the bill."

Section 32 of P.D. No. 1177 is hereby amended to read as follows:
"Sec. 32. Supplemental Appropriations. After the President shall have submitted the general appropriations
bill, supplemental appropriations measures shall be considered only if supported by actually available funds or
by new revenue measures."
The title of Section 35 is hereby amended to read "Reports on Guaranty Obligations."

A second paragraph is hereby added to Section 45 of P.D. No. 1177, as follows:
"Except as otherwise provided by law, the maximum number of permanent positions in a bureau, office or
agency shall not exceed the number of permanent positions included in the approved staffing pattern and in
the approved special budgets for the said bureau, office of agency: Provided, That savings from personal
services may be used to create additional positions to implement the regionalization of agencies under the
integrated reorganization of agencies under the integrated reorganization plan or for expansion of essential
services, subject to prior approval of the Commissioner of the Budget and to the provisions of Section 40

Section 55 of P.D. No. 1177 is hereby amended and augmented as follows:
"d. Payment of salaries or money value of vacation and sick leaves of employees who have been suspended or
dismissed as a result of administrative or disciplinary action, or separated from the service through no fault of
their own and who have been subsequently exonerated and/or reinstated by virtue of decisions of competent
"n. Payment of expenses incurred for confidential national security purposes which shall be accounted for
solely on the certification of the President as Commander in Chief, or the officers in charge of national
security missions as may be specifically designated by him;
"o. Obligations under perfected contracts approval by the President;
"p. Payment of outstanding obligations not exceeding P500.00 for each item of expenditure incurred in any
previous year, upon recommendation of the head of agency concerned and approval of the Commissioner of
the Budget, but without prejudice to the administrative liability of the official or employee responsible for the
incurrence of obligations in the absence of fund availability."

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 9th day of June, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and seventy-eight.
